strings.name: Vijay Shekhar Sharma
strings.summary: Trained in electronics and communications in Delhi, Sharma founded One97 and developed Paytm’s payments, merchant devices and financial-services distribution. After listing, the business faced growth and compliance pressures; he left the restricted Paytm Payments Bank’s board in 2024. In 2026 he also took charge of the payment-services subsidiary, while the group reported its first full-year net profit. The bank and listed operator are distinct entities.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Paytm and advanced Indian mobile payments and digital financial services, influencing online consumption and financial inclusion.

strings.highlights.h1.title: Merchant and consumer payments
strings.highlights.h1.text: Built Paytm’s mobile payments, merchant devices and financial-services distribution.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Governance and operating changes
strings.highlights.h2.text: Adjusted bank governance after regulatory disruption and pursued payment services and profitability at the listed company.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Company reviewed full-year profitability
strings.timeline.t1.text: An AGM review reported the first full-year profit after tax in FY 2026 and discussed AI services.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Additional subsidiary leadership
strings.timeline.t2.text: Appointed PPSL managing director and CEO effective January 29, subject to applicable approvals.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Left payments-bank board
strings.timeline.t3.text: Resigned as non-executive chair and director during regulatory restrictions and board restructuring.
strings.timeline.t4.title: One97 shares listed

strings.timeline.t5.title: Payments bank began operations
strings.timeline.t5.text: The central bank confirmed Paytm Payments Bank began operations on May 23.
strings.timeline.t6.title: In-principle bank approval
strings.timeline.t6.text: Was among eleven applicants receiving RBI approval in principle to establish payments banks.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founded One97
strings.timeline.t7.text: The company incorporated and began business, later becoming Paytm’s listed operator.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed engineering education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from Delhi College of Engineering and entered software-business development.
